price.label: Price
price.help: The day's open, high, low or close price, or yesterday's close.

sma.label: Simple moving average
sma.help: Average of the last N closing prices. Smooths out daily noise to show the trend.

ema.label: Exponential moving average
ema.help: Like a simple average over N days, but recent days count more, so it reacts faster.

rsi.label: RSI
rsi.help: Relative Strength Index, 0 to 100, over N days. Below 30 is often called oversold, above 70 overbought.

change_pct.label: % change over N days
change_pct.help: How much the close moved compared with N days ago, in percent. N = 1 means since yesterday.

highest.label: Highest high of last N days
highest.help: The highest price of the previous N days (today not included). Closing above it is a breakout.

lowest.label: Lowest low of last N days
lowest.help: The lowest price of the previous N days (today not included). Closing below it is a breakdown.

value.label: Number
value.help: A fixed number you type, e.g. 1 for 1% or 30 for RSI 30.
